integrity: Analytic proof controls both thresholds and all L>0; standard-library numerical tests are corroborative and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete curvature -1 hyperbolic plane, exactly three independent uniform-arclength terminals on a single finite horocycle segment; not general curves, sampling measures or more terminals. Historical priority remains provisional. A public 2004 deterministic source has year-only publication metadata and no verified first-public day.
title: Two sharp topology thresholds for random Steiner trees on a hyperbolic horocycle segment
